card.title: The Crown Must Pass
card.instruction: Treat another person as your likely successor. Prepare them to lead, then reclaim authority whenever their independence makes your influence feel temporary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my chair, deputy. Lead the meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: First, staff rotas won't need your approval anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent confidence. I'll need to approve that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already told the staff to send their rotas directly to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell them I'll do the final review beside you. You should see how approval works before abolishing it.
